saved.title: Saved

mortgage.title: Mortgage
mortgage.subtitle: Explore what fits your budget, then compare three ways to finance it.
mortgage.maxLoan: LTV loan limit at this price
mortgage.maxPriceHint: Budget uses 33% of income after obligations, a constant {{rate}}% illustrative rate, your term, tax and fees. Plan payments may differ.
mortgage.startBody: Enter a price, available cash and income to explore your options. You can also try an example.
mortgage.sessionNotice: Planning figures for this session. They are cleared when the app restarts.
mortgage.equityGapBody: This scenario needs more cash. Compare a lower price or adjust your planning details.

affordability.basis: Based on the first payment and net household income minus the obligations entered. Later payments may rise. This is not bank approval.

stable.name: Stable
stable.body: Mostly fixed and unlinked. Less exposure to rate changes, with a higher starting payment in this example.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.body: A blend of fixed, Prime and CPI-linked tracks. Some payments can change.

flexible.name: Flexible
flexible.body: More variable-rate exposure. A lower starting payment in this example, with greater uncertainty.

mortgage.compareHint: Same loan, term and CPI assumption across all three plans. Swipe horizontally to compare. Custom edits in a plan stay on its detail screen.
mortgage.noLoan: Your available cash covers the price and estimated purchase costs. No mortgage is needed in this scenario.
mortgage.taxExpired: Purchase-tax tables do not cover today’s date. Estimates are paused until the tables are updated.
mortgage.customizeHint: Changes here affect this plan only. Adjust the inputs to update all plans together.
mortgage.mixHint: Other tracks retain their relative mix. The editor keeps at least 34% in fixed unlinked interest.
mortgage.cpiHint: CPI affects linked tracks only. Each scenario holds CPI and interest rates constant; future rate resets are not forecast.
mortgage.totals: Over the life of the loan
mortgage.indexationHint: Total repayment = original loan + interest + CPI added to principal. CPI is shown separately from interest.
mortgage.ltvExceeded: This loan exceeds the {{limit}} financing limit for the selected buyer type.
mortgage.stressPayment: First payment if variable rates rise 1 percentage point
mortgage.stressHint: An immediate rate-shock illustration, not a forecast of when rates will reset.
mortgage.advisorCta: Get a real offer — talk to an advisor
mortgage.advisorPending: Consultation booking is coming in a later release. No request has been sent. Use these figures to prepare questions for your own advisor.
mortgage.propertyEmpty: Enter planning details to estimate the monthly payment and cash needed for this property.
mortgage.propertyHint: Balanced plan, using your session inputs and illustrative fallback rates.
mortgage.disclaimer: Planning estimate only, not financial or tax advice, a bank offer or a lending decision. Confirm affordability, eligibility and taxes with qualified professionals.

assumptions.title: Know the assumptions
assumptions.rates: Rates are illustrative fallback inputs, not current market averages or bank offers. Variable rates are held constant in the base scenario; CPI is an assumption.
assumptions.scope: For a standard new residential purchase by an Israeli resident. Excludes refinancing, loans already secured on this property, bridge loans, subsidized housing and special eligibility. Insurance and early-repayment charges are excluded.
assumptions.tax: Sole-home tax assumes legal eligibility. Replacement buyers use additional-home tax unless sole-home eligibility is explicitly selected. Special exemptions are not modeled.
assumptions.validity: Rules checked 12 Oct 2026. This calculator’s purchase-tax configuration covers 2026 only.

form.title: Your planning details
form.exampleBody: These are example figures. Replace them with your own before relying on the estimate.
form.privacy: Inputs stay in memory for this session. They are not saved to disk or sent to a server.
form.obligationsHint: Include loan payments, maintenance and other ongoing commitments. All entered obligations are deducted conservatively. Existing loans secured on the property need a separate bank assessment.
form.replacementHint: Sole-home tax treatment depends on the legal sale deadline and your circumstances. Select it only after confirming eligibility.
form.lawyerRate: Lawyer fee · % of price, including VAT
form.agentRate: Agent fee · % of price, including VAT
form.numberError: Enter a valid non-negative amount within the supported range (price must be positive).
form.fixErrors: Review the highlighted fields before calculating.

costs.title: Total cost of purchase
costs.hint: Fees are editable planning allowances, including VAT where applicable. Closing costs are funded from cash. Totals exclude future mortgage interest and CPI.

chart.title: How repayments change
chart.subtitle: Annual principal and interest payments in ₪. CPI additions are included in principal repaid; the values view lists indexation separately.

learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Israeli real estate, explained simply.
learn.emptyBody: Step-by-step guides and a full glossary are coming soon.

profile.title: Profile
profile.buyerProfileBody: Tell us about your household and finances to unlock mortgage plans.

filters.title: Filters
filters.withinBudgetHint: Complete your buyer profile to use this filter.

property.notFoundBody: It may have been sold or removed.

score.title: Potential Score
score.noneBody: We don't have enough data about this home yet.
score.missingBody: Insufficient data. This category is excluded and its weight is shared by the available categories.
score.method: Each available category is scored from 0 to 100. The total is the rounded weighted average. Development, daily amenities, access, relative pricing and property features inform the estimate; it is not a forecast of returns.
score.coverage: Confidence reflects coverage of the five categories, not investment certainty. Missing data reduces confidence. Displayed weights reflect redistribution; contributions may not add up exactly because of rounding.

market.title: Nearby deals & market
market.atMedian: In line with the neighborhood median
market.noHistory: Not enough price history to draw a trend.

mortgage.title: Your mortgage for this home
mortgage.body: Complete your buyer profile to see your estimated monthly payment and required equity.

property.cta: Talk to an expert before you buy

demo.title: Demo data
demo.body: Listings, plans, amenities, transport and price history are fictional. Scores use an uncalibrated preview model, not verified market data.

context.straightLine: Distances are straight-line estimates, not walking or driving routes.

plans.title: City plans nearby
plans.radius: Plans within 1 km; planned transit contributes to the score within 800 m.
plans.empty: No plans found in the surveyed area.
plans.select: Select a plan to highlight its boundary on the map.
plans.mapNativeBody: Open on iOS or Android to explore plan polygons. Plan details are available below.
plans.disclaimer: Plan status and proximity do not establish building rights or guarantee completion. Check official planning records before making a decision.

amenities.title: Daily life nearby
amenities.radius: Counts within 800 m. Distances are measured in a straight line; walking routes may be longer.

traffic.title: Traffic & transportation
traffic.noStop: No stop recorded in this survey.
